flows:

Remain on this public site.
Stop before sign-in, registration or payment.
Never change fixture settings.
Use only visible controls.
Verify the final result on the page.
In Common Length and Distance Conversions, assert that the To unit list fits entirely within the 320-pixel viewport.
Without horizontal scrolling, enter 1, choose feet in From and inch in To, and activate Convert.
Verify the result reads 1 feet = 12 inch.
